title: Ngeli ya I-I (Theme 6: Usawa wa kijinsia)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows mass and abstract nouns like sukari, chai, afya, amani are I-I and take i- with no plural.
contexts: gender equality (usawa wa kijinsia): amani nyumbani

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Afya ___meimarika baada ya matibabu." Kwa nini "zi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za I-I hazihesabiki, kwa hiyo hupatana na i-: afya imeimarika.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Njaa ___nauma tumboni." Kwa nini "u" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za I-I hupatana na i-: njaa inauma.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya I-I?" Kwa nini "kitabu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za I-I ni hali au mawazo yasiyohesabika, kama afya na njaa.
Nomino za I-I hazina wingi: sukari imeisha.

checks.question: Ni nomino ipi ya I-I: meza, afya?
